reflections.summary: Restrict and chain temporal links; aspect decision order; adverb/modifier attachment and re-entrancy rules; non-core role choices (:place, :medium, :part-of, :reason); classifiers kept as :unit; title brackets in names; have-degree-91 for comparison; but-91/contrast-91 take ARG1/ARG2; stricter same-event and fused-negation rules.

Firm temporal anchoring rules (aspectual verbs, nominal args, depends-on for present), no borrowed participants, fused-negation concept/aspect/modal, aspect rule 2 restricted, no wiki in Chinese, superlative over verb, history-phrase temporal, small role/coref fixes.

Fix aspectual-verb temporal direction and fame pattern; give relative-clause states and copulas modal (and RC states temporal) parents; fused-negation nested event parent = author; concrete belong-type role convention; restrict aspect step 2 (continue -> activity); alignment of repeated words.
